blocks.text: Buying a Townhome Under $1.2M in Maple Ridge: Top Neighbourhoods

parts.t: A budget under $1.2 million opens virtually the entire Maple Ridge townhouse market, ranging from older two- and three-bedroom complexes in West Central and Southwest Maple Ridge ($625,000–$775,000) to modern three- and four-bedroom family townhomes with side-by-side double garages in Albion, Cottonwood, and Silver Valley ($780,000–$1,100,000).

Families comparing townhomes in Albion and Cottonwood prioritize walkability to c'usqunela Elementary (10445 240B St), Albion Elementary (10031 240 St), Kanaka Creek Elementary (11180 234A St), Alexander Robinson Elementary (11849 239B St), Samuel Robertson Technical Secondary, and Thomas Haney Secondary, while Silver Valley buyers look for hillside complexes near Yennadon Elementary and Golden Ears Provincial Park.

blocks.text: Tandem vs. Side-by-Side Garages, Strata Rules & School Catchments

parts.t: When comparing Maple Ridge townhomes under $1.2M, pay close attention to garage layout (tandem two-car vs. side-by-side double garage plus driveway apron length), visitor parking rules, fenced backyard usable area (common property vs. limited common property), and the strata corporation's Contingency Reserve Fund and roof/exterior depreciation timeline.

Can I get a side-by-side double garage townhome in Maple Ridge under $1.2M?

Yes. While entry-level 3-bedroom townhomes in the $725,000–$825,000 range often feature tandem garages, many end-units and larger 3- and 4-bedroom townhomes between $830,000 and $1,100,000 in Albion, Cottonwood, and Silver Valley offer side-by-side double garages.
Which SD42 schools serve Albion and Cottonwood townhome complexes?

Depending on the exact street address, townhomes in Albion and Cottonwood fall into the catchments for Albion Elementary, c'usqunela Elementary, Kanaka Creek Elementary (year-round calendar), or Alexander Robinson Elementary, feeding into Samuel Robertson Technical Secondary or Thomas Haney Secondary.
Are there 55+ age-restricted rancher townhomes in Maple Ridge under $1.2M?
Yes. Maple Ridge has several 55+ adult-oriented rancher and one-and-a-half-storey townhome communities, primarily in West Central and East Central; you can also filter specifically on our
What should I check in a Maple Ridge townhome strata package?

Always review the Form B Information Certificate, two years of strata council and AGM minutes, the latest Depreciation Report (checking roof, siding, window, and deck timelines), pet and parking bylaws, and the strata insurance policy.
How is commuting from Maple Ridge townhome neighbourhoods?

Southwest and West Central townhomes offer the fastest access to Maple Meadows West Coast Express Station and the Golden Ears Bridge, while Albion and Cottonwood connect south down 240 Street to Lougheed Highway and Port Haney Station.
